title: Add a text note to a view and read notes back for review
task: Place annotation text in a view with TextNote.Create(document, viewId, position, text, textNoteTypeId) using a TextNoteType from the document, then collect the view's notes and read TextNote.Text back, trimming the trailing carriage return Revit appends.

pitfalls.symptom: A note's Text never equals the string that was written; string comparisons and JSON output show a stray character.
pitfalls.cause: TextNote.Text comes back with a trailing '\r' appended, even for single-line input; Autodesk's XML doc does not mention it.
pitfalls.fix: Trim with Text.TrimEnd('\r') before comparing or reporting (step 3).

pitfalls.symptom: TextNote.Create throws for the type id.
pitfalls.cause: An ElementId that is not a TextNoteType (e.g. a text style from a different family) was passed.
pitfalls.fix: Collect OfClass(typeof(TextNoteType)) and use one of those ids (step 1).
